sections.heading: Shopify Image Requirements
sections.body:
Before diving into AI generation, understand Shopify's image specifications:

Recommended Size: 2048 x 2048 pixels (square format preferred)

Max File Size: 20MB per image

Format: JPEG, PNG, or WebP

Aspect Ratio: Consistent across all product images for clean grid displays

AI-generated images at 1:1 ratio work perfectly for Shopify's default theme layouts.

sections.heading: Main Product Image Strategy
sections.body:
Your main product image appears in collection pages, search results, and cart. It needs to:

  • Show the product clearly and completely
  • Stand out in a grid of competitors
  • Load quickly (optimize file size)
  • Look professional at any size

Best Approach: Clean white or light gray background with soft shadows. The product should fill 80-85% of the frame. Use consistent lighting across all products.

sections.heading: Building Your Image Gallery
sections.body:
Shopify allows multiple images per product. Use this hierarchy:

Image 1 (Main): Clean product shot on neutral background

Image 2: Lifestyle shot showing product in use

Image 3: Scale reference or detail shot

Image 4: Alternative angle or color variant

Image 5: Ingredient list, sizing chart, or key features graphic

AI can generate images 1-4 instantly, dramatically reducing your launch timeline.

sections.heading: Theme Compatibility Tips
sections.body:
Different Shopify themes display images differently:

Dawn (Default): Square images work best. Gallery uses slider format.

Debut: Supports various aspect ratios. Test 1:1 and 4:3.

Minimal: Images zoom on hover. Ensure high resolution.

Custom Themes: Check your theme's product image settings before generating.

Generate at maximum resolution and let Shopify's CDN handle optimization.

sections.heading: SEO for Product Images
sections.body:
Optimize your AI-generated images for search visibility:

File Names: Use descriptive names like "organic-face-serum-lifestyle.jpg"

Alt Text: Write detailed descriptions for accessibility and SEO

Image Sitemap: Ensure product images are included in your sitemap

Structured Data: Use Shopify's built-in product schema for rich snippets

Well-optimized images can drive significant traffic from Google Image Search.

sections.heading: Workflow: From AI to Shopify
sections.body:
1. Generate images at 1:1 ratio with max resolution
  2. Download and review all generated assets
  3. Batch rename files with SEO-friendly names
  4. Compress if needed (TinyPNG, Squoosh)
  5. Upload to Shopify via product editor or bulk import
  6. Add alt text for each image
  7. Test across devices to ensure proper display

This workflow takes minutes instead of days with traditional photography.
